title: Safe to Send? Student Data and AI Services
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Three chutes sort six items into send it, fix it first, and never send it, with a warning that text sent to an AI service cannot be pulled back.

educational.topic: Which materials are safe to send to an AI service
learningObjectives: The learner will sort six items into send it, fix it first, and never send it, and state why the sorting matters.
prerequisites: Student data privacy and FERPA from [Chapter 13](../../chapters/13-automated-checks-cost-privacy/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Does it name or identify a student?
Can I take it back once it is sent?
commonMisconceptions: Deleting a chat removes what was sent
Removing the name from a gradebook is always enough
assessmentOpportunities: Why are quiz scores with names not safe as they are?
Can you take back text you pasted into an AI service?
What do you do if you are not sure an item is safe?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
